figurative_meaning_en: to annoy or pester someone by persistent bargaining or haggling
similar_in_english: to drive someone crazy with nagging
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাজারে দরদাম করতে করতে সে আমার মাথা খেয়ে দিল।
ছেলেটা খেলনা কিনতে গিয়ে দোকানদারের মাথা খাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He ate my head by bargaining endlessly at the market.
The boy is pestering the shopkeeper by haggling over the toy.
note: This idiom reflects the common bargaining culture in Bengali markets.
